description: This file defines the OA_Task_Runner class, which manages a collection of tasks, allowing them to be added, ordered, and executed sequentially. It includes methods for running tasks and adding new tasks with specific orderings.

classes.name: OA_Task_Runner
classes.description: A class for storing a collection of tasks and executing them in order.

methods.name: runTasks
methods.description: Executes each task in the collection sequentially, removing them from the queue after execution.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the collection, either appending, replacing, or inserting before/after a specified existing task.
